entries.title: Is PGx For Me?
entries.summary: Guide to who benefits from pharmacogenomic testing.
entries.body: PGx testing may be right for you if you: take prescription medications and want to know if they suit your DNA; manage chronic health conditions like diabetes, heart disease, or high blood pressure; have a family history of drug reactions or allergies; undergo psychiatric, cancer, or cardiac care requiring critical treatments; have experienced trial-and-error with medications without relief; want proactive, preventative personalized medicine. 70% or more receive at least one prescription annually that may not suit their DNA. 97% carry genetic variants affecting medication response. Providers evaluating PGx should consider integration into daily clinical practice across psychiatry, cardiology, oncology, and primary care.

entries.title: PGx Summary
entries.summary: MyEngene provides the most comprehensive PGx reporting in the industry.
entries.body: MyEngene provides the most comprehensive pharmacogenomic reporting in the industry. The platform translates patient genes into personalized drug recommendations to maximize effectiveness and minimize toxicity. Identifies DNA variations leading to dysfunctional enzymes affecting drug metabolism. Physicians receive clear reports to confidently suggest optimal therapies. Covers 990+ drugs across 1,110 genes. Reports include dosing guidelines, drug-gene interactions, drug-drug interactions, and lifestyle factors. Delivered in 5-7 business days with physician review. Reduces adverse drug reactions — the 4th leading cause of death in the USA affecting 128,000 Americans annually. Potential to reduce ADR costs by up to 95%.
